summary: Something just special happens when you give someone a website. Even better when it's connected to a passion. Forget the privacy benefits just being able to shape your own truth online. That is power. It's something we could all do right now to make the world better.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Something just special happens when you give someone a website. Even better when it's connected to a passion.

Forget the privacy benefits just being able to shape your own truth online. That is power.

It's something we could all do right now to make the world better.
